title: Preserve tuning labels independently from pitches
scope: Retain authored staff tuning labels while keeping the existing MIDI tuning authority explicit.
acceptance: Two staves with identical MIDI strings and different labels remain distinct.
Label-only edits do not change sounding pitches, string order or capo.
Assert empty and named tunings through GPIF import and independent GP8 consumption.
exclusions: GP3 through GP5 do not author tuning labels; their imported Staff.TuningName remains empty.

reproduction.instructions: Two staves with identical MIDI strings and different labels remain distinct.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Covers staff-local named and empty GPIF labels, identical pitches, label-only edits, exact GP8 wire fields, and Go reimport.
Pinned AlphaTab independently consumes named and explicit empty labels without changing tuning pitches or capo.
Pinned GPIF importer assigns Label to Staff.stringTuning.name independently from Pitches.
Pinned GPIF writer emits the staff tuning label alongside the independently ordered pitch array.

Checked identical string pitches with different staff labels, label-only edits, track fallback, absent versus explicitly empty labels, exact GPIF, and independent consumer labels/pitches/capos. GP3-5 do not author tuning labels.
